items.title: Graftway
items.text:
Graftway aims to make build-system dependency graphs useful for build planning, CI, and developer tooling. Its initial focus is Bazel, with local queries and a Linux-hosted service.

The project is in early development. See the contribution guide to get involved and the changelog for project updates.

Graftway is dual licensed under MIT or Apache-2.0.

items.title: Development
items.text:
Install Git and mise. On Intel macOS, install Xcode Command Line Tools to build Mr Boxington. Review the repository configuration before approving mise's trust prompt.

Before submitting a change, run these commands from the repository root:

mise run fmt
mise run check

Use mise tasks to discover individual checks and mise tasks deps check to inspect the validation graph. For focused Python work, mise run test:python -k "navigation or tag" selects tests, and mise run lint:python --fix applies lint fixes. These tasks accept the underlying tool's arguments, including --help.

Use mise run docs:serve to preview documentation. Keep user guides under docs/ and project information under docs/meta/, and update navigation in zensical.toml when adding or moving pages.

items.title: Pull requests
items.text: Open pull requests against main using the pull request template. Contributions follow the project's licensing terms.
